(2023), and CrewAI CrewAI (2024) provide Python APIs for building multi-agent applications. They are excellent at composing agents within a single application, but they are not wire protocols: two systems built with different frameworks cannot interoperate without custom bridges, and none of them defines a cross-framework notion of intent, conflict, or resolution authority. MPAC sits one level below these frameworks—any of them could use MPAC as its coordination wire format.
